rationale: Adopt X6 v3 as the target for the React browser-only graph editor. v2 is deprecated and is not the long-term target. The browser spike passes after adding tslib, the core bundles the official plugins, and the React shape package is available. Native Node/SSR is explicitly not approved: the published v3 package currently fails native ESM and CJS loading. The actual application regression suite must pass before production rollout. maxGraph remains the fallback if the v3 migration fails.
criteria: Permissive licence; commercial licences are excluded
React integration and official React shape support
General diagram editing parity: shapes, ports, selection, transform, undo/redo, clipboard, stencil, export
Supply chain, provenance and dependency footprint

alternatives_considered.name: X6 v3 3.1.8
alternatives_considered.reason: Cheapest migration from the existing React X6 app; maintained line; official React shape package; browser spike passed.

alternatives_considered.name: maxGraph 0.25.1
alternatives_considered.reason: Apache-2.0, zero dependencies and provenance, but no official React wrapper and still 0.x; adapter undo/redo is partial.

alternatives_considered.name: React Flow 12.12.1
alternatives_considered.reason: Excellent React node/flow editor, but not a general draw.io-style diagram editor.

alternatives_considered.name: diagram-js
alternatives_considered.reason: Production BPMN/process modeler toolkit; not a generic shape/stencil library and not React-native.

alternatives_considered.name: X6 v2 2.19.2
alternatives_considered.reason: Deprecated; retain only until the v3 migration and regression pass.

conditions: Browser-only deployment; native Node/SSR is not approved.
Add tslib explicitly and verify the bundler.
Keep v2 pinned only as a short migration bridge.
Run the actual application regression across custom React nodes, selection, transform, history, clipboard, stencil, snapline, minimap and export.
Pin X6 3.1.8 exactly and record the npm provenance gap.

reversal_cost: Moderate for X6 v3: import, plugin and React provider changes. High for maxGraph: editor-layer rewrite.
review_triggers: The v3 migration fails in the actual application.
v3 native packaging remains broken for a required runtime.
AntV stops maintaining v3 or a relevant security advisory appears.
maxGraph reaches 1.0 or proves full editing parity.
The React shape package breaks or stops being maintained.
